Hi Sana / team — happy to confirm details from the engineering side. A few technical pre-reqs and what we'll run during the 30-minute load block:

Pre-reqs (prework checklist mirrors these):
- Open outbound HTTPS to api.redwood.ai and allow TCP 443 for Zoom recording if you're hosting recording behind a firewall.
- Share the redacted CSV (500 rows) via the Drive link; please include column mapping (prompt, user_id, context).
- If you have any lengthier prompts (2k+ tokens), flag them — we'll exercise longer-seq kernels.

Planned load run (30 min):
- 5 min: baseline warm-up + KV cache priming with the sample dataset
- 20 min: steady-state short-burst runs (batching tuned to 8/16) to surface latency percentiles
- 5 min: quick scale-down and capture token-cost summary

I'll include a minimal command to push test requests (we'll run from our staging pool):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <staging-token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-llama-7b","prompt":"{{prompt}}","max_tokens":256}'

I'll add the Zoom link and calendar invite in the next message once time is final.

--
